name: The Ghost
description: Six rounds of one minute each on the rower, in burpees and in double-unders, followed by a minute of rest. The score is the reps of each movement.
source_notes: crossfit.com/workout/2014/06/17 (official CrossFit daily workout archive), retrieved 2026-10-16; 1 minute on each movement, then 1 minute of rest, six times; score the total of each movement
